name: Lysosomal Disease with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
aliases: Lysosomal Storage Disorder with Cardiac Hypertrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Lysosomal Disease with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Echocardiographic evidence of unexplained hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
Demonstration of deficient lysosomal enzyme activity in leukocytes or fibroblasts
Identification of pathogenic mutation in lysosomal storage disorder-related gene
Presence of systemic manifestations such as hepatosplenomegaly or skeletal abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of unexplained hypertrophic cardiomyopathy plus either lysosomal enzyme deficiency or pathogenic genetic mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

searchTerms: thickened heart muscle worsening over time

pathognomonic.symptomName: Lysosomal enzyme deficiency confirmed by biochemical assay
searchTerms: biochemical assay positive for enzyme lack
bone growth disorder with stiff joints
abnormal bones and limited joint movement

common.symptomName: Exercise intolerance due to cardiac dysfunction
searchTerms: poor exercise tolerance due to heart issues

laboratory: Reduced activity of specific lysosomal enzymes in blood or fibroblasts
Elevated urinary glycosaminoglycans or other storage metabolites
imaging: Echocardiography showing concentric left ventricular hypertrophy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes encoding lysosomal enzymes (e.g., GAA, GLA, or others depending on subtype)
other: Histological evidence of lysosomal storage material in biopsy specimens

distinguishingFeatures: Lack of systemic manifestations such as hepatosplenomegaly or skeletal abnormalities

redFlags: Rapidly progressive cardiac hypertrophy in infancy or childhood
Presence of systemic signs such as hepatosplenomegaly or skeletal deformities
Family history of lysosomal storage disorders or unexplained cardiomyopathy
references: Orphanet: Lysosomal Disease with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (ORPHA:217581)
Muenzer J. The mucopolysaccharidoses: a heterogeneous group of disorders with variable pediatric presentations. J Pediatr. 2004.
Elliott PM, Anastasakis A, Borger MA, et al. 2014 ESC Guidelines on diagnosis and management of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Eur Heart J. 2014.
